title: Creamy Curry Chicken with Vegetables & Rice
author: Family Recipe

step.title: Marinate chicken
step.text: Mix the chicken with curry powder and soy sauce. If possible, let it soak for a while so the chicken absorbs the flavor.

step.title: Sauté onions
step.text: Quickly sauté the onions until softened. There is no need to brown them.

step.title: Add vegetables
step.text: Once the chicken is fully cooked, add the washed frozen carrots and peas.

step.title: Add mini corn
step.text: Add the canned mini corn and mix everything together.

step.title: Prepare sauce
step.text: In a separate pot, mix the flour, Maggi, optional Vegeta, and optional vegetable oil. Slowly add the cold water while whisking continuously to prevent lumps.

step.title: Add cream
step.text: Add the heavy whipping cream and whisk until smooth.

step.title: Prepare rice
step.text: Prepare the rice separately in another pot.

step.title: Cook chicken
step.text: Add the marinated chicken to the sautéed onions. Season with salt and pepper and cook until the chicken is fully cooked.

step.title: Add vegetables
step.text: Add the frozen carrots and peas, followed by the canned mini corn. Mix everything together.

step.title: Add sauce
step.text: Pour the creamy sauce directly into the pot with the chicken and vegetables. Mix everything together.

step.title: Let it boil
step.text: After everything has been added, let it come to a boil and cook together until everything is well combined and heated through.

step.title: Serve
step.text: Serve the creamy curry chicken and vegetables with the rice.

notes: Use cold water when mixing with flour to prevent lumps. Vegetable oil is optional. Use 1 small spoon of curry powder.
